No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need a new mattress today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid ə nu ˈmætrəs təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我今天想買一張新床墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You came at a good time, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju keɪm æt ə ɡʊd taɪm sɜr./
dialogue.zh: 先生，您來的時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old one sags in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld wʌn sæɡz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 我那張舊的中間都塌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How old is that one now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About nine years, maybe ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is longer than its life.
dialogue.zh: 那已經超過它的壽命了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wake up with a sore back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ʌp wɪt ə sɔr bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft spot can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote my bed size on this card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt maɪ bɛd saɪz ɑn ðɪs kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我把床的尺寸寫在這張卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, let me see it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty inches wide, eighty long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a queen size bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a queen the same as mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə kwiːn ðə seɪm æz maɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 加大雙人跟我那張一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, queen beds use these numbers.
dialogue.zh: 對，加大雙人就是這數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My room is rather small, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How wide is the door there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bedroom door is twenty nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A boxed queen fits through that.
dialogue.zh: 紙箱裝的加大床也進得去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also measured my bed frame.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the frame sets the height.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow your tape measure?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is a long one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wall chart lists every size.
dialogue.zh: 這面牆上列了所有尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the width you need.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twin, full, queen, then king.
dialogue.zh: 單人、標準雙人、加大、特大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A twin is for one sleeper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son wants one for his room.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn wɑnts wʌn fər hɪz rum./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子也想幫他房間買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a twin may work there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I sleep here with my wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ slip hɪr wɪt maɪ waɪf./
dialogue.zh: 但我跟太太一起睡這張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a queen fits you both.
dialogue.zh: 所以加大雙人夠你們兩個睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we want more room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A king gives more space to roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɪŋ ɡɪvz mɔr speɪs tu roʊl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bedroom is only twelve feet.
dialogue.zh: 我們寢室只有十二英尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A king would fill it right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɪŋ wʊd fɪl ɪt raɪt ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my pen smudged this.
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我的筆把這張卡片弄髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no rush here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old one weighs about ninety.
dialogue.zh: 我們那張舊的大約九十磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then two of us can carry it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tu ʌv ʌs kæn ˈkæri ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell boards for frames?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, next to the beds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My frame has no middle board.
dialogue.zh: 我的床架中間那塊板不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That can make a mattress sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, so the bed may not be dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ ðə bɛd meɪ nɑt bi dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 噢，所以那張床可能還有救。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, nine years is a long time.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl naɪn jɪrz ɪz ə lɔŋ taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need something easy to move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam beds are lighter to lift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And our stairs are quite narrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us check that before you buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tʃɛk ðæt bɪˈfɔr ju baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 買之前我們先確認一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you write the size down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, queen sixty by eighty.
dialogue.zh: 給您，加大雙人六十乘八十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a tall man need more length?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə tɔl mæn nid mɔr lɛŋθ?/
dialogue.zh: 高個子需要更長的床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add four inches past your height.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am six feet two myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then eighty inches gives you room.
dialogue.zh: 那八十吋讓你伸展得開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife is much shorter than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf ɪz mʌtʃ ˈʃɔrtər ðæn mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So length is not your worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the thickness of beds?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most here are ten or twelve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a thick one feel softer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It depends on the foam inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the queen bed on display.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə kwiːn bɛd ɑn dɪˈspleɪ./
dialogue.zh: 請帶我看展示的那張加大床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one here is our queen.
dialogue.zh: 這張就是我們的加大款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me use your tape on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi juz jʊr teɪp ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我用你的捲尺量一下它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, take the length first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty inches, just like my note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your note was worth the trip.
dialogue.zh: 有這張記錄，這趟就沒白跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the width matches too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, so your size is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should also check my old sheets.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd ˈɔlsoʊ tʃɛk maɪ oʊld ʃiːts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Queen sheets fit a queen bed.
dialogue.zh: 加大的床單配加大的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those are still in good shape.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you only need the mattress.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my frame height normal?
dialogue.zh: 我床架的高度算正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most frames hold ten to twelve.
dialogue.zh: 多數床架撐十到十二吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate extra shopping trips.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us pick the feel now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs pɪk ðə fil naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, my bed is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ maɪ bɛd ɪz loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我的床很低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A queen on this frame sits higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwiːn ɑn ðɪs freɪm sɪts ˈhaɪər./
dialogue.zh: 這款加大床放上床架會高一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Higher is easier on my knees.
dialogue.zh: 高一點膝蓋比較不費力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, so aim for twelve inches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write that on my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ raɪt ðæt ɑn maɪ kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以寫在我的卡上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, it helps later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is taller than my old bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈtɔlər ðæn maɪ oʊld bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pick a shorter one, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn pɪk ə ˈʃɔrtər wʌn ðoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I like this height.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can call the size done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn kɔl ðə saɪz dʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for checking that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Now, how firm do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm naʊ haʊ fɜrm du ju wɑnt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is what I came to ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt aɪ keɪm tə æsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us talk soft and firm first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tɔk sɔft ænd fɜrm fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife likes a very soft bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf laɪks ə ˈvɛri sɔft bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you prefer a firm mattress.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is our whole problem.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們的全部問題就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a middle choice, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A middle one might please us both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɪdəl wʌn maɪt pliz ʌs boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 中間那個也許讓我們都滿意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what most people buy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not know sizes were tricky.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ ˈsaɪzəz wɜr ˈtrɪki./
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道尺寸這麼麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Measuring first saves you a return.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing I asked for your tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ aɪ æskt fɔr jʊr teɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now come look at the firm beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ kʌm lʊk æt ðə fɜrm bɛdz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what do these tags say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one reads medium firm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you call the plush one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju kɔl ðə plʌʃ wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call that plush, very soft.
dialogue.zh: 那個我們叫柔軟型，很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plush sounds nice but risky.
dialogue.zh: 柔軟型聽起來不錯但也有風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hugs your shoulders and hips.
dialogue.zh: 它會包住你的肩膀和臀部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my wife sink in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, that is the point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What holds you up in a firm bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt hoʊldz ju ʌp ɪn ə fɜrm bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thick base foam layer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these foam or springs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This row is all foam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the spring beds, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind you, the older style.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They make a noise, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old ones do, new ones are quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld wʌnz du nu wʌnz ɑr ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 舊款的會，新款的很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet is good news for us.
dialogue.zh: 安靜對我們來說是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam is quiet, and it keeps heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊm ɪz ˈkwaɪət ænd ɪt kips hit./
dialogue.zh: 泡棉安靜，而且會留住熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm is bad for me at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɪz bæd fər mi æt naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then try this hybrid, springs plus foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn traɪ ðɪs ˈhaɪˌbrɪd sprɪŋz plʌs foʊm./
dialogue.zh: 那試試這張複合式，彈簧加泡棉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a hybrid gives both things?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cool air and a soft top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kul ɛr ænd ə sɔft tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife kicks the covers off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So she sleeps hot, I see.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That wakes us both up often.
dialogue.zh: 那樣常把我們兩個弄醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam holds the heat more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a cool kind of foam?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə kul kaɪnd ʌv foʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, gel foam, look at this tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒɛl foʊm lʊk æt ðɪs tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，凝膠泡棉，看這張標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the gel do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pulls heat away from you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that change how firm it is?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt tʃeɪndʒ haʊ fɜrm ɪt ɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, gel is about temperature.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, one worry gone already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have more, but we can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv mɔr bʌt wi kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 還有別的，但可以待會再談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press this with your hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See how fast it comes back?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soft one stays dented a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔft wʌn steɪz ˈdɛntɪd ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm foam bounces back faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which is better for my back?
dialogue.zh: 哪一種對我的背比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually firm, but not too hard.
dialogue.zh: 通常是硬一點，但不要太硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is hard the same as firm?
dialogue.zh: 很硬和有支撐是一回事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, firm supports, hard just pushes.
dialogue.zh: 不一樣，硬是撐住，太硬是頂人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a good way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd weɪ tə seɪ ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say it every day here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have extra firm too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, near the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who buys the extra firm one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly larger people, or older backs.
dialogue.zh: 大多是體型大的人，或是長輩的背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am not that heavy, luckily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then medium firm is your range.
dialogue.zh: 那中硬就是你要的範圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium firm, I will remember that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on your little card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the edge matter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sit on the edge daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old one drops when I sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld wʌn drɑps wɛn aɪ sɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam edges need a firm wall.
dialogue.zh: 泡棉的邊需要一圈硬牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this one have that firm wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs wʌn hæv ðæt fɜrm wɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel it, push near the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Solid, it does not fold over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has good edges.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We share the bed, so edges count.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃɛr ðə bɛd soʊ ˈɛdʒəz kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個人睡，所以邊緣要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then motion transfer matters too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Motion transfer, what is that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When I move, do you feel it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ muv du ju fil ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我動的時候，你會感覺到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife moves all night long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam stops that better than springs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So foam wins on that point.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, springs pass the motion along.
dialogue.zh: 對，彈簧會把動作傳過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything bad about foam, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds you in, and runs warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ju ɪn ænd rʌnz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 它會把你困住，而且悶熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And it costs more, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, but this sale helps you.
dialogue.zh: 有時候，但這波特價幫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many layers does this have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, plus a thin soft top.
dialogue.zh: 三層，再加一個薄軟的表層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do tops wear out first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, after eight or nine years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I want a thick top.
dialogue.zh: 那我想要厚一點的表層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for four inches of foam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tag here says three inches.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that one is a cheaper build.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðæt wʌn ɪz ə ˈtʃipər bɪld./
dialogue.zh: 那張就是較便宜的用料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds cheap, but I am not sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz tʃip bʌt aɪ æm nɑt ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 聽起來便宜，但我還是不太確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the price is not all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I compare two side by side?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kəmˈpɛr tu saɪd baɪ saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a row open now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which two should I start with?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The medium firm and the hybrid.
dialogue.zh: 中硬那張跟複合式那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they far apart in price?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two hundred, for a queen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a real difference.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel first, then talk money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lie down on them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, ten minutes each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes seems long in a store.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts simz lɔŋ ɪn ə stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在店裡躺十分鐘好像很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people rush, and regret it.
dialogue.zh: 多數人躺一下就走，後來後悔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lie down with my shoes on?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ laɪ daʊn wɪð maɪ ʃuz ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以穿著鞋躺上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have covers for shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor looks clean enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wipe each bed every night.
dialogue.zh: 我們每晚都擦每一張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I am ready to lie down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ æm ˈrɛdi tə laɪ daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right this way, take your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am lying on my back.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ æm ˈlaɪɪŋ ɑn maɪ bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does your lower back feel?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat, it does not push up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that means it supports.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hips do not sink much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hips should stay in line.
dialogue.zh: 臀部應該要保持成一直線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In line with what, though?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With your shoulders and head.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will roll onto my side now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl roʊl ˈɑntu maɪ saɪd naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does your shoulder feel there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed, but not sore yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a full two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use a pillow too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, take the firm one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one is too tall for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ɪz tu tɔl fər mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the soft one under it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, my neck is straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what you want here.
dialogue.zh: 躺在店裡要的就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My timer says six minutes left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not rush, sit and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife is here with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring her over, let her try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɪŋ hɜr ˈoʊvər lɛt hɜr traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那請她過來，讓她躺躺看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says it feels too soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New foam softens more at home.
dialogue.zh: 新泡棉在家會再軟一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I want to test motion.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the other corner, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pushed, did she feel it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She barely moved, that is good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the springs, it was worse.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can feel the difference here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡一比就差得出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Getting up is not a fight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some beds trap you in them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I close to ten minutes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, then we move on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That wall clock never moves.
dialogue.zh: 牆上的鐘好像都不會動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your phone, I will wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine minutes, one more to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the last minute easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now the hybrid next door.
dialogue.zh: 好，再來是隔壁那張複合式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lie down, compare it honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one lifts me more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the spring layer again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also runs cooler, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Air moves through those coils.
dialogue.zh: 空氣在那一圈圈彈簧裡流動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are coils just springs, then?
dialogue.zh: 所以彈簧圈就是彈簧嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, coils is the shop word.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like both, that is bad news.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk boʊθ ðæt ɪz bæd nuz./
dialogue.zh: 兩張我都喜歡，這就難辦了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write a note, pick one winner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card says soft, cool, steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which word matches which bed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hybrid wins on those three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is your first choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do display beds match boxed ones?
dialogue.zh: 展示床跟紙箱裡的內容一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same inside, only wrapped.
dialogue.zh: 一樣，裡面相同，只是包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this same feel comes home?
dialogue.zh: 那這種舒服的感覺會跟著進家門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that is our promise.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，這是我們的保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till it feels right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it about thirty nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty nights to get used to it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti naɪts tə ɡɛt juzd tə ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body needs that much time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would my wife notice a change?
dialogue.zh: 我太太會感覺到差別嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually in the first week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me how she should lie.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, on the medium firm one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your back on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels flat and calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm is a good word for beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm ɪz ə ɡʊd wɜrd fər bɛdz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I use it a lot, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, my neck is bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do not sleep on your stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn du nɑt slip ɑn jʊr ˈstʌmək./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I turn to my side mostly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side sleepers need a soft top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this hybrid have that top?
dialogue.zh: 這張複合式有那個表層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four inches of gel foam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders sank on the plush.
dialogue.zh: 軟的那張我肩膀陷下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is too soft for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz tu sɔft fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那張對你們來說太軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep saying yes to soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people do, then they ache.
dialogue.zh: 多數人都這樣，然後起床腰酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, medium firm hybrid, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Solid pick, you tested it well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sit on it a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi sɪt ɑn ɪt ə bɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在上面坐一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, sit near the middle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It holds me, does not tip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tipping, we tested that too.
dialogue.zh: 不會傾，這個我們也測過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do other buyers write here?
dialogue.zh: 其他買家留言都寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back pain, ten out of ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a lot of people.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our best selling bed.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們賣最好的一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best selling makes me a bit wary.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈsɛlɪŋ meɪks mi ə bɪt ˈwɛri./
dialogue.zh: 賣太好反而讓我有一點戒心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it again, take more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, I want to be sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl aɪ wɑnt tə bi ʃʊr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how to buy a bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz haʊ tə baɪ ə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more lie down, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr laɪ daʊn ɪz ðæt faɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, nobody is waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the one, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now we talk delivery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delivery, that is the hard part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why, is there a problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My place is up three flights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us start there, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three flights, and no elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a walk up, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can your men carry it up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two men come, that is normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for stairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small carry charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How small are we talking?
dialogue.zh: 你說的小，是小到多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty dollars, per flight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three flights, so that is sixty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, so we add it to the order.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt soʊ wi æd ɪt tə ði ˈɔrdər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the turn at the top tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tɜrn æt ðə tɑp taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 樓頂那個轉彎會很擠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about your landing.
dialogue.zh: 跟我說說你的樓梯平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second floor has a hard turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈsɛkənd flɔr hæz ə hɑrd tɜrn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is where boxes scratch walls.
dialogue.zh: 那個位置最容易刮到牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They cover the walls, right?
dialogue.zh: 他們會把牆保護起來吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with pads and plastic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hallway is quite narrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How wide, do you remember?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About thirty inches, maybe less.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A queen fits, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old one came in sideways.
dialogue.zh: 我們舊的那張是側著進去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then yours is a tight house.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it come rolled in a box?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ɪt kʌm roʊld ɪn ə bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 它可以捲起來裝箱送嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that hybrid ships rolled.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那張複合式是捲裝出貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A box is much easier here.
dialogue.zh: 裝箱對我這邊容易多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One man can carry that up.
dialogue.zh: 一個人就能把它搬上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the box say which side up?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə bɑks seɪ wɪtʃ saɪd ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Arrows on both ends, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I clear my bedroom first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, leave a path to the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs liv ə pæθ tə ðə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they call before they come?
dialogue.zh: 他們來之前會先打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They call an hour before.
dialogue.zh: 他們會提前一小時打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to be home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, someone must sign for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife is home on Fridays.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick Friday for the truck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do trucks start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early, some start at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight is too early for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can ask for after noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After noon costs extra, though?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the window is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the noon window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I note that on the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ noʊt ðæt ɑn ðə faɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they leave it on the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ liv ɪt ɑn ðə bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 他們可以直接放床上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They set it on the frame.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And take the box away?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they fold it and go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they open it in front of me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ ˈoʊpən ɪt ɪn frʌnt ʌv mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you ask them to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to watch it unroll.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes ten minutes to grow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the stairs are too tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə stɛrz ɑr tu taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 要是樓梯真的過不去呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they bring it back here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for that trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small return fee, only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will measure the stairs tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me a photo tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A photo helps more than numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, the photo shows the turn.
dialogue.zh: 兩個都要，照片看得到轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my card enough for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we need real measurements.
dialogue.zh: 不夠，我們要有實際尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stair fee could change, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, but only a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would rather know it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can write a flat rate.
dialogue.zh: 我可以給你一個固定價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flat rate sounds great.
dialogue.zh: 一聽到固定價我就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty flat, up to three flights.
dialogue.zh: 六十元固定，三層以內都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even if I move to the fourth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ɪf aɪ muv tə ðə fɔrθ?/
dialogue.zh: 就算我搬到四樓也一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four flights costs eighty, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third floor, then we are set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set, and the men know it.
dialogue.zh: 定了，搬運的師傅也會知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they carry up the frame too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ ˈkæri ʌp ðə freɪm tu?/
dialogue.zh: 床架也能一起搬上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The frame comes in two boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boxes are lighter, I know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your son can help with those.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is twelve, is that allowed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can hold the door open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody is carrying anything heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, that is our job.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they wear covers inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth ones, over their shoes.
dialogue.zh: 布做的鞋套，套在鞋外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My floors are new, I worry.
dialogue.zh: 我家地板是新鋪的，我會擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are careful people, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the truck is late?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the number on your receipt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt comes with the order?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We email it today, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The email is written on there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check away, no rush from me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, all correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last stair thing, the door.
dialogue.zh: 最後一件跟樓梯有關，門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Measure the door, too, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty nine, I wrote it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that clears the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the stairs are settled now.
dialogue.zh: 這樣樓梯的事就確定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, the photo confirms it.
dialogue.zh: 差不多，照片確認就穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, I have a return question.
dialogue.zh: 接下來，我有一個退換的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, let us talk trial nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many nights can I try it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni naɪts kæn aɪ traɪ ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety nights, from delivery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety nights is almost three months.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the whole winter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the trial start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts the day they deliver.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a minimum night count?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep it thirty nights first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty before I can return it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your back needs time to change.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if forty nights feel wrong?
dialogue.zh: 要是睡了四十晚還不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then call us, we come get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kɔl ʌs wi kʌm ɡɛt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You come to my door for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʌm tə maɪ dɔr fər ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你們會到我家門口來搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the same truck, same men.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for that pickup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pickup is free in the trial.
dialogue.zh: 試睡期內回收是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the money come back to?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə ˈmʌni kʌm bæk tə?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back on the card you used.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days for the money?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten days, sometimes five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I exchange instead of return?
dialogue.zh: 我能換貨而不是退貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one swap is free here.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在這裡免費換一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap means a different firmness?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any firmness, even a new size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the swap start a new trial?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə swɑp stɑrt ə nu ˈtraɪəl?/
dialogue.zh: 換貨會重新算試睡期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the nights keep counting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fair, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some shops restart it, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What ruins the trial, then?
dialogue.zh: 那什麼情況會讓試睡失效？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stain, or no cover on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə steɪn ɔr noʊ ˈkʌvər ɑn ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cover means a protector?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no protector, no refund.
dialogue.zh: 所以沒套床套就不退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the rule, sadly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy one, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we have them right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the warranty cover?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years against deep sag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep is a deep sag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One inch, measured with a rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that include the foam top?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all layers, one number.
dialogue.zh: 包含，每一層都算一個數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the warranty on paper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on your receipt, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the tag on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tag, for one year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag on the corner, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not cut it, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep tags from everything.
dialogue.zh: 我什麼東西的標籤都留。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, returns are faster then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my wife also read the terms?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ waɪf ˈɔlsoʊ rid ðə tɜrmz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take this one page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line says no refund fees?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, no restock fee here.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們不收重新入庫費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a restock fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some shops charge ten percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do not charge that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here, we want you to keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪr wi wɑnt ju tə kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不收，我們希望你留下這張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the delivery fee, back too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delivery comes back, the stair fee does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈlɪvəri kʌmz bæk ðə stɛr fi dʌz nɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I lose the sixty then?
dialogue.zh: 所以那六十元就花掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that part stays paid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, the men climbed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people agree with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the trial once or twice?
dialogue.zh: 試睡只能用一次還是兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once per person, per year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is plenty, I hope.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So do I, every single sale.
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼希望，每一筆都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you do with a returned bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju du wɪt ə rɪˈtɜrnd bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 退回來的床你們怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We clean it, sell it as open box.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi klin ɪt sɛl ɪt æz ˈoʊpən bɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open box means cheaper, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and that is honest work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the trial cover the frame?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frames must stay, only the bed.
dialogue.zh: 床架不能退，只能退床墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I return the protector too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it is still sealed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealed means not opened yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the plastic must stay closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will open it at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the usual way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take this sheet home?
dialogue.zh: 這張說明我可以帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, read it with her.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing I do not like.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, I can answer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety nights is a long promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep our promises here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do many people use the trial?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one in ten, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn ɪn tɛn ðæt ɪz ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One in ten feels honest.
dialogue.zh: 十分之一聽起來很真實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, we would not lie.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I am ready for the cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ æm ˈrɛdi fər ðə ˈkʌvər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mite covers are this way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mite covers, what do they do?
dialogue.zh: 防蟲床套，它們是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep tiny bugs out of beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kip ˈtaɪni bʌɡz aʊt ʌv bɛdz./
dialogue.zh: 它們把小蟲擋在床外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son sneezes all morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this is not optional.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not optional, I like that rule.
dialogue.zh: 不能省略，我喜歡這規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the trial alive too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the sizes, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We start with your queen card.
dialogue.zh: 先從你那張加大尺寸開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These hang in a long row.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cover for every bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one stops the mites?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The zip around one, like this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It covers all six sides?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is an encasement.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the small print here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists the hole size, see?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holes small enough to stop bugs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole trick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this one breathable?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, air moves, but water does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɛr muvz bʌt ˈwɔtər dʌz nɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a hard mix, cool and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə hɑrd mɪks kul ænd draɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We test each one twice a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɛst itʃ wʌn twaɪs ə jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it make noise when I move?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt meɪk nɔɪz wɛn aɪ muv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not this one, no plastic sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife hears every small sound.
dialogue.zh: 我太太一點聲音都聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this cloth one is for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs klɔθ wʌn ɪz fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels like a thick shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cotton top, mite layer under.
dialogue.zh: 上面是棉，下面是防蟲層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it change how the bed feels?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt tʃeɪndʒ haʊ ðə bɛd filz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a little, it is thin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep does it go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits twelve inch beds, too.
dialogue.zh: 十二吋深的床也包得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My new bed is twelve inches.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this is your size exactly.
dialogue.zh: 那這個就剛好是你的尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the zipper, how long is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈzɪpər haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs three whole sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three sides means easy on and off.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri saɪdz minz ˈizi ɑn ænd ɔf./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it has two pulls.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pulls, so I do not stretch.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pʊlz soʊ aɪ du nɑt strɛtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 兩個拉頭，我就不用硬拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, it saves your hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often should I wash it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once a month, in hot water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot water is what kills them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one hundred and ten, minimum.
dialogue.zh: 對，水溫至少一百一十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a number I can forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈnʌmbər aɪ kæn fərˈɡɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the label inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I dry it in the sun?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ draɪ ɪt ɪn ðə sʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but no hot machine please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the sun hurt the layer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour in the sun is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊr ɪn ðə sʌn ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 曬一個小時太陽沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, this pack has two covers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two, it saves you a trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ tu ɪt seɪvz ju ə trɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One for the wash, one for the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fər ðə wɑʃ wʌn fər ðə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the smart way to own them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə smɑrt weɪ tə oʊn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 那樣備著才是最聰明的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What colors do you keep here?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡有哪幾種顏色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White and gray, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White is easier to see stains.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, and it washes brighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also sell pillow covers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same cloth, two in a pack.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪm klɔθ tu ɪn ə pæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son needs those, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His nose will thank you tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚他的鼻子就會感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those the same holes inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same cloth, cut in a square.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the queen cover?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty, or sixty for the pair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty for two is not bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and it protects nine hundred.
dialogue.zh: 對，它守的是九百元的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It protects the bed I paid for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt prəˈtɛkts ðə bɛd aɪ peɪd fər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly what it does.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the one you use at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə wʌn ju juz æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 你自己在家也用這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do, on all three of ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɑn ɔl θri ʌv ˈaʊərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three beds, you sleep a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sell covers, so I must.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that is a fair answer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also, my daughter has allergies.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She sneezes like my son does.
dialogue.zh: 她跟我兒子一樣打噴嚏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the pair is your best buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə pɛr ɪz jʊr bɛst baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那兩個裝就是最划算的買法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the two pack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will put it aside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the box for small holes.
dialogue.zh: 幫我檢查盒子有沒有破洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me open the flap here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seams look straight to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tight seams, no loose thread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this bag is for storage?
dialogue.zh: 這個袋子是用來收納的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds the spare one clean.
dialogue.zh: 備用的那個放進去就乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I lose things in a drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪ luz θɪŋz ɪn ə drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我在抽屜裡常弄丟東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all do, that bag helps.
dialogue.zh: 大家都一樣，那個袋子很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this size match the card?
dialogue.zh: 這個尺寸跟我卡上的一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Queen here, your card says queen.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是加大，你卡上也是加大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One worry, does it slip off?
dialogue.zh: 還有一點擔心，它會滑下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It zips shut, nothing slips.
dialogue.zh: 拉鏈一關，什麼都不會滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing slips, that is what I asked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ slɪps ðæt ɪz wʌt aɪ æskt./
dialogue.zh: 不會滑，這正是我要問的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked twice, so I said it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju æskt twaɪs soʊ aɪ sɛd ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你問了兩次，我就答兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, does it fit the frame?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes right over the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old bed will not need one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld bɛd wɪl nɑt nid wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我那張舊床不用買套了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one leaves on Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 不用，那張週四就搬走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the old mattress, the haul.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk that in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn tɔk ðæt ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, the money part, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us count the tags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add it up, I want to hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ɪt ʌp aɪ wɑnt tə hɪr ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed, frame, cover, then the fees.
dialogue.zh: 床墊、床架、床套，再加費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a real list now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and a coupon helps.
dialogue.zh: 對了，還有折扣碼可以用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupon? Now that I like.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, we will do the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn wi wɪl du ðə mæθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us sit, then add it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs sɪt ðɛn æd ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我們坐下把金額加一加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the screen right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed is eight ninety nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the sale price, not the old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə seɪl praɪs nɑt ði oʊld./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was it before the sale?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thousand and forty, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So that is one hundred forty off?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðæt ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti ɔf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred and forty one, exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the frame, two fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The frame is not on sale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cover get a discount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but two in a pack do.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt tu ɪn ə pæk du./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但兩個裝比較划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then keep the pack price.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty, as I read it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the stair fee of sixty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Added, that is a flat rate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the line before tax?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One two six nine, all in.
dialogue.zh: 一二六九，全都算進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is without the coupon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, unless you have one.
dialogue.zh: 正確，除非你手上有一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card says ten percent off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where did that card come from?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shop gave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is good on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɪz ɡʊd ɑn ðə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only on the bed, not all?
dialogue.zh: 只能用在床墊，不是全部？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the bed, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə bɛd ðæt ɪz ðə rul./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten percent of the old price?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is one hundred four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stack the sale and coupon?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stæk ðə seɪl ænd ˈkupɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 特價和折扣碼能疊加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one discount per bed.
dialogue.zh: 不行，一張床只能用一種折扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which one is better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sale, by a small bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me both numbers, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把兩個數字都給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, side by side on paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupon first, that is one three zero six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkupɑn fɜrst ðæt ɪz wʌn θri ˈziroʊ sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 折扣碼那一條是一三○六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the sale line, one two six nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə seɪl laɪn wʌn tu sɪks naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 特價那一條是一二六九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the sale saves me thirty seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə seɪl seɪvz mi ˈθɜrti ˈsɛvən./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty seven, yes, take that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is tax in that number yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, tax comes at the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add it, I want the true total.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ɪt aɪ wɑnt ðə tru ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 加上吧，我要真正的總額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One three five eight, with tax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that slow, I write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðæt sloʊ aɪ raɪt ɪt daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thousand, three hundred, fifty eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the whole thing, no extras?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl θɪŋ noʊ ˈɛkstrəz?/
dialogue.zh: 這就是全部，沒有別的費用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all, unless you tip.
dialogue.zh: 就這些，除非你要給小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tipping is not on the bill?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is for the two men.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz fər ðə tu mɛn./
dialogue.zh: 不在，那是給搬運師傅兩人的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can pay by card, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, or split it in three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split how, and no fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three payments, spread by month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds better than card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs you nothing extra.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small deposit today, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty holds your truck day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty now, rest on delivery.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the usual way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, what date works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have trucks till Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday is out, family day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Saturday, or Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday is four days from now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or this Thursday, one day sooner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days is fast, I worry.
dialogue.zh: 三天好快，我有一點擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box is already in back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, if it does not rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain or shine, we still come.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Thursday, not Friday, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday it is, morning window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning? I said after noon.
dialogue.zh: 早上？我選的是中午過後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me fix that line, one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi fɪks ðæt laɪn wʌn ˈmoʊmənt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the window on the paper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is now, see the change.
dialogue.zh: 現在有了，看到改動了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, noon to four, perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We put that on every file.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get an order number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, two seven zero five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me take a picture of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər ʌv ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep it with the terms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the sale show on the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə seɪl ʃoʊ ɑn ðə rɪˈsit?/
dialogue.zh: 特價會顯示在收據上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows as a minus line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like seeing a minus line.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡看到扣減那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone does, it is my job.
dialogue.zh: 大家都愛，這是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything cheaper I missed?
dialogue.zh: 有沒有更便宜的被我漏掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The floor model, two hundred less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one I lay on today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but someone else may want it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɛls meɪ wɑnt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep a new one, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ə nu wʌn θæŋks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, new is worth the extra.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，新的值得那個差價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print two copies, for my wife.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for each of you, done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now about that old mattress.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us finish that, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is still in my bedroom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we need a plan for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi nid ə plæn fər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can your crew take it away?
dialogue.zh: 你們的人可以把它載走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do that on the same run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ du ðæt ɑn ðə seɪm rʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the same day, that is music.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə seɪm deɪ ðæt ɪz ˈmjuzɪk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, let me check the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə fi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the haul away free, then?
dialogue.zh: 那舊床墊搬走是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is free with a new bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fri wɪt ə nu bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no twenty dollar fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee, but there are rules.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rules for my old mattress?
dialogue.zh: 對我那張舊床墊的規定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It must be dry and clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry, like not wet at all.
dialogue.zh: 乾的意思就是一點都不濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wet bed cannot ride with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt bɛd ˈkænɑt raɪd wɪt ʌs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cat made a small accident.
dialogue.zh: 我家貓曾經尿了一小塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wash the spot, and dry it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɑʃ ðə spɑt ænd draɪ ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is still up on the third floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz stɪl ʌp ɑn ðə θɜrd flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They carry it down, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkæri ɪt daʊn ðæt ɪz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們會把它抬下樓，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down three flights with the new up?
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn θri flaɪts wɪt ðə nu ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 新的送上樓，舊的抬下樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same trip, in and out together.
dialogue.zh: 同一趟，一進一出一起完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to strip the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə strɪp ðə bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take off sheets and pads.
dialogue.zh: 要，床單和保護墊都拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pads go in the wash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep those, they are yours.
dialogue.zh: 那些自己留著，那是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the frame, do they take it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə freɪm du ðeɪ teɪk ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your frame stays with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the frame is still strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this is only about the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs ɪz ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 那就只有床墊這一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should the old one be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the hall, or by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɔl ɔr baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall is shared, nine doors.
dialogue.zh: 走廊是共用的，有九個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then leave it inside your door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they wrap it in plastic?
dialogue.zh: 他們會用塑膠袋包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big bags, right there.
dialogue.zh: 會，很大的袋子，就在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use that bag at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ðæt bæɡ æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我在家可以用那個袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one, it is free today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the old one recycled or lost?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði oʊld wʌn riˈsaɪkəld ɔr lɔst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Recycled, the foam becomes pads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam becomes pads, that is neat.
dialogue.zh: 泡棉能變成墊子，滿妙的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We like that part of the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi laɪk ðæt pɑrt ʌv ðə dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 我們也喜歡工作這一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My city wants a yellow tag.
dialogue.zh: 我的城市要貼黃色標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some cities do, not ours.
dialogue.zh: 有些城市要，我們這裡不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I need no tag on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ nid noʊ tæɡ ɑn ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tag, just bag it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag it tonight, I will ask her.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ ɪt təˈnaɪt aɪ wɪl æsk hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 今晚套袋，我請她一起弄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hands make that fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the crew come early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they keep the noon window.
dialogue.zh: 不會，他們守住中午那個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New up, old down, then truck.
dialogue.zh: 新的上樓，舊的下樓，上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is twenty minutes, total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, I can wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch them, it is fun to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðɛm ɪt ɪz fʌn tə si./
dialogue.zh: 你看著吧，那個挺有意思的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my neighbor wants to go too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf maɪ ˈneɪbər wɑnts tə ɡoʊ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我鄰居也想丟舊的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One haul per order, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 一筆訂單只能清運一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is mine, that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His bed can wait next month.
dialogue.zh: 他那張可以下個月再處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The neighbor's twin is old, too.
dialogue.zh: 鄰居那張單人床也舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take that for thirty, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 那張我們收三十元，也許。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty for a small twin bed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one is not free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add it, then, for thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Added, thirty on the day, same truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈædɪd ˈθɜrti ɑn ðə deɪ seɪm trʌk./
dialogue.zh: 加進去了，那三十元當天現付，同一部車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will mark it on my wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl mɑrk ɪt ɑn maɪ wɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it by the door too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign for the old going out?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ saɪn fər ði oʊld ˈɡoʊɪŋ aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 舊的搬走我也要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line, new in, old out.
dialogue.zh: 只簽一行，新的進、舊的出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sign once, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your copy, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt says haul away now?
dialogue.zh: 收據上現在寫了清運嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, see, it is printed there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I do not like surprises.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neither do we, honest work.
dialogue.zh: 我們也不愛，做事要老實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dog will bark at them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep him in another room.
dialogue.zh: 先把牠關在另一個房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He loves new boxes, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let him smell the box.
dialogue.zh: 那就讓牠聞聞那個箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, the sheets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash the new ones before Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 週四之前先把新的洗過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the first night, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New beds do smell a bit.
dialogue.zh: 新床確實會有一點味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bad kind of smell?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light smell, it goes in a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪt smɛl ɪt ɡoʊz ɪn ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有一點味道，一天就散了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A day is nothing, I wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well from Thursday on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, three flights, one bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a covered mattress on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back thanks you already.
dialogue.zh: 我的背已經先謝謝你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our test beds help my back too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər tɛst bɛdz hɛlp maɪ bæk tu./
dialogue.zh: 店裡的試躺床也救我的背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You stand all day, do you rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju stænd ɔl deɪ du ju rɛst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lunch, and ten minutes on a bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌntʃ ænd tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɑn ə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, like our rule.
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘，跟我們的規矩一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rule works, I must say.
dialogue.zh: 這條規矩有用，我必須說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I pay the fifty?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk, right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card for that, then paper here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, your copy is signed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed and dated, Thursday's fine.
dialogue.zh: 簽名寫日期，週四沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bag, one receipt, one truck.
dialogue.zh: 一個袋、一張收據、一部車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a whole plan, now.
dialogue.zh: 這樣整個計畫就成立了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and you know it by heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd ju noʊ ɪt baɪ hɑrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do, three flights, Thursday noon.
dialogue.zh: 我記得了，三樓、週四中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the long talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, sir, and write us.
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，先生，再寫評語給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, the bed is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ðə bɛd ɪz wɜrθ ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Thursday, third floor then.
